candidates.title: Hospital Inpatient Discharges (SPARCS De-Identified): 2023
candidates.publisher: New York State Department of Health

fields.name: Hospital Service Area
fields.description: A description of the Health Service Area (HSA) in which the hospital is located. Blank for enhanced de-identification records.  Capital/Adirondack, CentralNY, Finger Lakes, Hudson Valley, Long Island, New  York City, Southern Tier, Western NY.

fields.name: Hospital County
fields.description: A description of the county in which the hospital is located. Blank for records with enhanced de-identification.

fields.name: Operating Certificate Number
fields.description: The facility Operating Certificate Number  assigned by NYS Department of Health. Blank for records with  enhanced de-identification.

fields.name: Permanent Facility Id
fields.description: Permanent Facility Identifier. Blank for records with  enhanced de-identification.

fields.name: Facility Name
fields.description: The name of the facility where services were performed based on the Permanent Facility Identifier (PFI), as maintained by the NYSDOH Division of Health Facility Planning. For records with enhanced  de-identification, ‘Redacted for Confidentiality’ appears.

fields.name: Age Group
fields.description: Age in years at time of admission/visit. Grouped into the following age groups: 0 to 17, 18 to 29, 30 to 49, 50 to 69, and 70 or Older.

fields.name: Zip Code - 3 digits
fields.description: The first three digits of the patient's zip code.

fields.name: Gender
fields.description: Patient gender.

fields.name: Race
fields.description: Patient race.

fields.name: Ethnicity
fields.description: Patient ethnicity.

fields.name: Length of Stay
fields.description: The total number of patient days at an acute level and/or other than acute care level (excluding leave of absence days).

fields.name: Type of Admission
fields.description: A description of the manner in which the patient was admitted to the health care facility.

fields.name: Patient Disposition
fields.description: The patient's destination or status upon discharge.

fields.name: Discharge Year
fields.description: The year (CCYY) of discharge.

fields.name: CCSR Diagnosis Code
fields.description: AHRQ Clinical Classification Software Refined (CCSR) Diagnosis Category Code.

fields.name: CCSR Diagnosis Description
fields.description: AHRQ Clinical Classification Software Refined  (CCSR) Diagnosis Category Description.

fields.name: CCSR Procedure Code
fields.description: AHRQ Clinical Classification Software Refined  (CCSR) ICD-10 Procedure Category Code.

fields.name: CCSR Procedure Description
fields.description: AHRQ Clinical Classification Software Refined  (CCSR) ICD-10 Procedure Category Description.

fields.name: APR DRG Code
fields.description: The All Patients Refined Diagnosis Related Groups (APR-DRG) Classification Code.

fields.name: APR DRG Description
fields.description: The APR-DRG Classification Code Description.

fields.name: APR MDC Code
fields.description: . All Patient Refined Major Diagnostic Category (APR MDC) Code.

fields.name: APR MDC Description
fields.description: All Patient Refined Major Diagnostic Category (APR MDC) Description.

fields.name: APR Severity of Illness Code
fields.description: The APR-DRG Severity of Illness Code.

fields.name: APR Severity of Illness Description
fields.description: All Patient Refined Severity of Illness (APR SOI) Description.

fields.name: APR Risk of Mortality
fields.description: All Patient Refined Risk of Mortality (APR ROM) Description.

fields.name: APR Medical Surgical Description
fields.description: The APR-DRG specific classification of Medical, Surgical or Not Applicable.

fields.name: Payment Typology 1
fields.description: A description of the type of payment for this occurrence.

fields.name: Payment Typology 2
fields.description: A description of the type of payment for this occurrence.

fields.name: Payment Typology 3
fields.description: A description of the type of payment for this occurrence.

fields.name: Birth Weight
fields.description: The neonate birth weight in grams.

fields.name: Emergency Department Indicator
fields.description: The Emergency Department Indicator is set based on the submitted revenue codes.

fields.name: Total Charges
fields.description: Total charges for the discharge.

fields.name: Total Costs
fields.description: Total estimated cost for the discharge.
